chapter_note: Classic editorial seam pattern. The substrate is a 10-fold enumeration of cosmic chariots/mounts (Vessel of Light, First Man's abode, Pillar of Glory, Call, Answer, Living Air, Living Wind, Light, Water, Fire) — a clean cosmological correspondence sequence. Then at i=22-27 the editor adds a parallel 4-fold "mounts in the flesh" applying the same enumeration pattern to ecclesial categories (Elect men, Elect women, catechumens, catechumenae). The page-level fatigue score confirms this: cosmological vocabulary drops from 24.1→8.2 while ecclesial vocabulary jumps from 0→23.8 in the second half. Notably, segment 29 says "twelve chariots" while the chapter title says "fourteen" (10+4) — suggesting textual layering where the ecclesial 4 was added after an earlier 10+2 or 12 structure. Title also says "Four Mounts" in segment 1 but chapter is about fourteen — indicating multiple editorial passes.
